name: WORKFLOW PACKS

packs: bugfix (reproduce -> diagnose -> patch -> focused_test -> regression -> review -> report)
ci_fix (inspect_checks -> read_logs -> identify_root_cause -> patch -> rerun_focused_ci -> report)
code_review (diff_inventory -> risk_classification -> correctness -> security -> tests -> review_report)
feature (requirements -> design -> implementation -> tests -> acceptance -> report)
research (question_decomposition -> source_collection -> source_quality -> synthesis -> citation -> artifact)
scientific_eval (protocol_freeze -> data_integrity -> leakage_checks -> execution -> metrics -> reproduction -> verdict)
release (version -> changelog -> build -> security_scan -> artifact_checksum -> smoke -> rollback_plan)

features: Deterministic step DAG generation per workflow pack
No automatic git merge or production release without permission approval
